definitions.explanation: A public display of works of art or items of interest.

examples.japanese: {美術|びじゅつ}{展覧会|てんらんかい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to an art exhibition.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}{展覧会|てんらんかい}を{開|ひら}く。

notes: Often abbreviated to {展|てん} in compound words like {美術展|びじゅつてん} (art exhibition).
